morphology.pattern_note: 资料包没有提供普通词义。可核实 Kuljit 作为人名出现，但不能据此确认该小写语料项的具体指称，也不能认证为官方马来语普通词。按人名使用时应写作 Kuljit；不得把开头 ku 误拆为马来语附着代词。is_root 仅表示本条不作马来语派生分析；无可核实的马来语派生词族。[马来西亚医药理事会姓名记录](https://merits.mmc.gov.my/viewDoctor/11638/search)

senses.zh_definition: Kuljit：人名，可音译为“库尔吉特”；当前没有足够依据把它解释为马来语普通词。
senses.en_definition: Kuljit, a personal name; not established here as a Malay common noun.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang, lazimnya ditulis Kuljit; makna sebagai kata umum bahasa Melayu belum dapat disahkan.
senses.nuances: 本项为有证据支持的专名解释，不是 DBP 官方普通词释义。资料包所给小写拼写仍保留在 headword.word 中；例句采用符合专名规范的大写形式。以下称呼组合是教学示例，并非经过语料统计的高频固定搭配。具体读音应向姓名持有人确认，故 IPA 留空。[马来西亚医药理事会：Kuljit Singh](https://merits.mmc.gov.my/viewDoctor/11638/search)

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kuljit dah sampai kat kafe ke? Aku nak gerak sekarang.
messages.ms_standard: Adakah Kuljit sudah tiba di kafe? Aku mahu bertolak sekarang.
messages.zh: Kuljit 到咖啡馆了吗？我现在准备出发。
messages.en: Has Kuljit reached the café? I’m about to head out.

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, dia tunggu kat dalam je. Datanglah.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, dia sudah tiba dan sedang menunggu di dalam. Marilah.
messages.zh: 到了，就在里面等着呢。过来吧。
messages.en: Yes, Kuljit’s waiting inside. Come on over.

etymology.historical_story: An official Malaysian medical register records Kuljit within a personal name, providing evidence for a name reading rather than a common-word definition. A name can occur naturally in Malay documents without becoming a Malay vocabulary item. The packet supplies no historical account, so its original meaning and route into this dataset remain unverified. [Malaysian Medical Council](https://merits.mmc.gov.my/viewDoctor/11638/search)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Kuljit 放进手机联系人，而不是普通物品词表：大写首字母提示“这是人名”。
